title: Great News for Tesla Stock Investors as a Merger With SpaceX is More Likely | TSLA Stock | SPCX
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc works through growing rumours of a SpaceX takeover of Tesla, sparked by a Barclays analyst raising his Tesla price target to $450 from $370 and upgrading the stock to overweight, after which Tesla rose about 6%. He argues any deal would need a large premium: Tesla trades at about $395-$396, so a $400 offer would not win the shareholder vote, and at least 10% — about $440, probably closer to 20% or $480 — would be needed. The merger makes business sense to him, simplifying Elon Musk's dual chief-executive workload, but not on valuation: he calls Tesla significantly, if not ridiculously, overvalued, and SpaceX also richly valued, though less so, with any deal likely paid in stock rather than cash. The more important point for Tesla holders is downside protection: takeover speculation puts a floor under the price, since a fall to $300 or $200 would make an acquisition easier for SpaceX to digest. He makes no explicit call of his own in this video. The calls are TSLA — UNCERTAIN and SPCX — UNCERTAIN, passing opinions only, against prior explicit calls of SELL on Tesla and HOLD on SpaceX.
